title: Platform admin
subtitle: Tenants, plans, support access and platform health. Every action here is audited on the target organisation.

orgs.createHint: Creates the tenant, its default roles and the owner. The owner receives an invitation when they have no account yet.
orgs.invitationHint: No account exists for {{email}} yet — share this invitation token with the owner (shown once).
orgs.ownerLinked: The owner already had an account and is now a member.
orgs.ownerEmailHint: Existing accounts are added as owner; otherwise an invitation is created.
orgs.emptyHint: Create the first tenant to get started.
orgs.changeStatusHint: Suspending blocks sign-in for every member; closing schedules the tenant for retention purge. The reason is audited and visible to the tenant's owners.
orgs.closeWarning: Closing an organisation is a retention event: data purge is delayed 7 days and blocked by legal hold.
orgs.reasonHint: At least 3 characters; recorded in the audit log.

grants.title: Support access grants
grants.hint: Time-boxed access for platform administrators to this tenant's data. Read grants default to 8 h; write grants need a second approver.
grants.createHint: Grant yourself time-boxed access to {{org}}. The tenant's owners can see this grant.
grants.reasonHint: At least 10 characters — what you need to look at and why.
grants.approvedByHint: Write grants require a second platform administrator's approval.
grants.revokeHint: Access ends immediately. The grant stays in the audit trail.
grants.emptyHint: Grants appear here when a platform administrator requests access to a tenant.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.hint: Per-organisation overrides of the platform defaults. Resetting removes the override.
